name: elacity-player
description: Play an owned, protected video (fMP4/CENC) via MSE. Satisfies the elastos.viewer/media@1 interface; consumes only scoped decrypted segments over a session handle, never the CEK or IV.
author: elastos

interfaces.description: Play protected fMP4/CENC media over a scoped decrypt session handle

methods.description: Open a protected media asset via MSE, consuming only scoped decrypted segments
